scope.source: canonical Model3 reproduction, individual pollen self-exclusion and fully joint three-locus diploid Mendelian offspring law

exact_identity: If P is random clipped Gaussian simplex, and C|P~Multinomial(N,P), then Cov(C/N)=E[(diag(P)-P P^T)/N]+Cov(P), which is generally not (diag(q)-q q^T)/N
interpretation: Conditional multinomial resampling eliminates the largest-remainder overestimate in this source derived 27-class comparison but produces class-richness underestimation, not a calibrated unbiased correction.
The Gaussian simplex variation and conditional sampling contribute separately to genotype frequency covariance, which exceeds the source multinomial covariance in the checked cases.

At multi-generation K32 the class-richness gap is smaller than the prior largest-remainder run but experimental cohorts differ; this is an exploratory comparison, not clean causal mediation of the previous horizon gap.
Despite improved class-richness agreement at some horizons, occupied trait mean discrepancies, rare genotype loss, variance and survival still require independent source-matching validations.
No full mutation-enabled SDE/SPDE or convergence result; the faithful reference remains discrete finite genotype Markov recurrence.
